episodes.synopsis: Valt arrives in Barcelona, where he meets a junior BC Sol player Kit Lopez and a BeyTrainer named Raul.
episodes.title: Fresh Start! Valtryek's Evolution!

episodes.synopsis: Since he missed his first day at BC Sol, Valt has to battle for the one remaining slot on the roster. His opponent is his old friend Rantaro!
episodes.title: Fighting Spirit! Berserk Roktavor!

episodes.synopsis: BC Sol holds internal tryouts to select their squad against Sunbat United. To represent the club, they'll have to defeat team captain Free De La Hoya.
episodes.title: Drain Fafnir! Winding Up!

episodes.synopsis: The match against Sunbat United starts, and Valt and Rantaro get the nod for BC Sol. They find themselves facing a familiar face.
episodes.title: Whirlwind! Tempest Wyvron!

episodes.synopsis: BC Sol and Sunbat United continue their face off. Valt and Silas show how much they've evolved since their last match.
episodes.title: Surprise Attack! Kinetic Satomb!

episodes.synopsis: In the aftermath of the match with Sunbat United, BC Sol shakes up its A-team roster. Silas and Django each make a difficult decision.
episodes.title: Squad Shake Up!

episodes.synopsis: Stan blames Valt for Django's decision. Despite tensions on the team, it's soon time for tryouts for the European League.
episodes.title: Journey to the Top!

episodes.synopsis: The European League kicks off with BC Sol facing German team Top Wand. Valt makes a new friend, Cuza, but soon winds up facing him in the arena.
episodes.title: Season Opener! European League!

episodes.synopsis: With BC Sol and Top Wand tied, Valt and Cuza face off for a rematch. Meanwhile, Theodore Glass continues to try and recruit Free to his team.
episodes.title: Alter Cognite! The Shape Shifter!

episodes.synopsis: BC Sol's victory only brings more tension. Silas wants more play time, resentment towards Valt and Rantaro grows, and then Free makes an announcement.
episodes.title: Free to Launch!

episodes.synopsis: With Free gone, Valt and Rantaro are promoted to BC Sol's first string for their matches against the Swedish team, but thing's don't go well.
episodes.title: BC Sol! A Team Divided!

episodes.synopsis: BC Sol faces French team AS Gallus. Valt and Rantaro get thrown off the roster when they’re caught talking with Daigo, a player on the opposing team.
episodes.title: The Return of Doomscizor!

episodes.synopsis: Back on the A squad, Valt faces his old friend Daigo in two intense matches. They've both come a long way from Beigoma Academy Bey Club.
episodes.title: Twin Scythes! Double Strike!

episodes.synopsis: The European League matches continue and BC Sol faces off against the Royals, whose star player has a grudge against Silas.
episodes.title: Attack! Maximus Garuda!

episodes.synopsis: After Valt and Rantaro's matches, Ghasem and Silas face each other again. Meanwhile, Valt receives some disturbing news about an old friend.
episodes.title: Ghasem! The Airborne Blader!

episodes.synopsis: Valt, Rantaro, Daigo and Wakiya head to Mexico, where Shu went missing. After meeting up with Cuza, they learn about the Snake Pit Organization.
episodes.title: The Search for Shu!

episodes.synopsis: Still inside the Snake Pit, Valt and his friends face the masked Shadow Bladers, who somehow have Beys exactly like their own!
episodes.title: Shadow Magic! The Snake Pit!

episodes.synopsis: Valt and his friends take on the Snake Pit's Bladers: a psychic, an acrobat, and an arctic aficionado. To find Shu, they all have to win!
episodes.title: The Underground Maze

episodes.synopsis: Azure Eye is a powerful opponent, but Valt's learning fast. Then he and his friends face Red Eye and Violet Eye in a battle royal!
episodes.title: Secret Fire! Red Eye!

episodes.synopsis: Back in Spain, BC Sol starts training for the World League, but some of the Bladers aren't happy when an old friend arrives.
episodes.title: New Teammates! New Rivals!

episodes.synopsis: Famous actor and Big Five Blader Joshua Burns arrives to film his new movie, and Valt, Rantaro and Cuza are cast as the villainous Space Ninjas!
episodes.title: Joshua vs. the Space Ninjas!

episodes.synopsis: Shooting for the movie continues, but Wakiya has his sights set on fighting Joshua for real stakes, not just on the set.
episodes.title: Blast Jinnius! Caller of Storms!

episodes.synopsis: BC Sol needs a new trainer. When they find a seasoned veteran, he's invited for a trial period, but Kris has some family history with him.
episodes.title: Infinity Stadium! Raul's Challenge!

episodes.synopsis: The World League is about to begin, and everyone is busy with their final preparations. Joshua reveals his reason for joining the Raging Bulls.
episodes.title: World League! Setting the Stage!

episodes.synopsis: Valt receives an unexpected letter from Xander, who's in Brazil working towards earning a spot on the highly esteemed SB Rios.
episodes.title: Showdown! Surge Xcalius!

episodes.synopsis: BC Sol and the Royals face each other in a rematch for the ages. With help from Rickson and Raul, Valt trains to master his Genesis Reboot move.
episodes.title: Genesis Reboot!

episodes.synopsis: The next World League battle, between SB Rios and Sunbat United, is scheduled for Japan! Which means Valt and his friends get to go home for a visit.
episodes.title: Worlds Collide! Home Turf!

episodes.synopsis: Valt and his friends head to France to cheer Daigo and his team on in the big showdown between AC Gallus and BC Galleon.
episodes.title: Vampire! Deep Caynox!

episodes.synopsis: For their battle against SB Rios, BC Sol head to Brazil, where they get into some trouble at the Bey Carnival.
episodes.title: The Fortress! Shelter Regulus!

episodes.synopsis: The semi-finals begin, with BC Sol facing SB Rios and AS Gallus battling the Raging Bulls. With advancement on the line, no one's holding back!
episodes.title: Collision Course! To the Finals!

episodes.synopsis: Valt and his friends are still battling for a place in the finals. Both Cuza and Valt face off against Ren Wu, one of the elite Big 5 Bladers.
episodes.title: Big 5! Breaking Through!

episodes.synopsis: Daigo and Joshua Burns battle for a spot in the finals and Xander faces his ultimate rival, Valt. Everything is riding on these matches!
episodes.title: Unrivaled! Triple Saber!

episodes.synopsis: The World League finals begin at last, with BC Sol facing off against the Raging Bulls. Lui is only one of many familiar faces making a reappearance!
episodes.title: The World League Final!

episodes.synopsis: The battles continue, and the tension is rising. With the final match looming, Free faces Silas while Valt goes up against Joshua.
episodes.title: Full Power! Spring Attack!

episodes.synopsis: The World League final's final match: Silas versus Joshua, BC Sol versus the Raging Bulls. After all their hard work, there can only be one winner!
episodes.title: To the Podium!

episodes.synopsis: Red Eye returns to stake his claim as the ultimate Blader, accepting a match against Lui. Red Eye's secret identity is revealed, shocking everyone.
episodes.title: Lúinor vs. Spryzen!

episodes.synopsis: A new global Blading tournament is announced: the International Blader's Cup! He's already qualified, but Valt vows to train even harder than ever.
episodes.title: Challenge of Champions!

episodes.synopsis: Free returns to BC Sol, but not all of his former teammates are ready to bury the hatchet. Shu is overtaken by a mysterious power.
episodes.title: Requiem Project! Spryzen Unleashed!

episodes.synopsis: The International Blader's Cup is about to begin, but Valt and Kit get distracted by a shady underground arena where fierce Bladers compete.
episodes.title: Emperor of the Underground!

episodes.synopsis: The Cup kicks off with Valt chosen to face off against Kurt in an epic battle for the ages.
episodes.title: Bow Down! Boom Khalzar!

episodes.synopsis: The battles for the Cup continue, with the Snake Pit alumni squaring off against each other. Boa faces Shu, then Norman battles Clio and Cuza.
episodes.title: Colossus Hammer! Twin Noctemis!

episodes.synopsis: Wakiya's suspicions about the Cup grow while the battles rage on. Silas prepares a new technique as Valt and Cuza square off.
episodes.title: BC Sol Scorcher!

episodes.synopsis: Shu and Kurt battle for victory while Joshua prepares to fight Free once again as the winners rise and the losers continue to fall.
episodes.title: White Hot Rivals!

episodes.synopsis: The leaderboards aren’t looking too great for BC Sol's Bladers. To survive the next round, Valt, Silas and Cuza will have to level up or go home!
episodes.title: Epic Evolution! Strike Valtryek!

episodes.synopsis: In the fourth round, Valt finally faces his former best friend Shu and his infamous Bey, Requiem Spryzen. Valt will have to give it his all to win.
episodes.title: Spryzen the Destroyer!

episodes.synopsis: In the wake of his match with Shu, Free tells Valt about a dangerous new training method before facing Lui.
episodes.title: No Limits! Free vs. Lui!

episodes.synopsis: Free and Lui's battle concludes, and Norman and Shu face each other in a Snake Pit rematch. Valt faces Boa for a chance to advance to the next round.
episodes.title: Full Force! Charging Up!

episodes.synopsis: Cuza and Valt each face off against the Emperor himself: Kurt! Boa decides to leave the Snake Pit, but not before telling Valt a shocking secret.
episodes.title: Teamwork! To the Semi-Finals!

episodes.synopsis: Four Bladers advance to the semi-finals of the International Blader's Cup. Shu faces off against Lui, while Valt prepares for his match against Free.
episodes.title: The Fierce Four!

episodes.synopsis: After his match with Free, Valt's family and friends come to cheer him on for the final round of the tournament: a rematch against his oldest friend.
episodes.title: Breaking Point! Bursting Through!

episodes.synopsis: Valt faces Shu one last time, with everything on the line: the title of World's Strongest Blader, his pride and his friend's very soul. Let it rip!
episodes.title: A Champion Is Crowned!
